text: {"lessons":["Short-term price changes are unpredictable, so I should not assume recent gains or losses will continue.","Frequent checking and trading can tempt me to react to small fluctuations; I should make deliberate decisions rather than trade without a clear reason.","I made no trades so far, and my account value still fluctuated; I should keep risk and diversification in mind instead of judging decisions by a brief run of results."]}
